vb_textbox.text: Make sure you have your hands on both the S and K keys at all times, as well as the space bar. I don't know if this is true, but there seems to be a way to always get high points. A particular gnome will usually give more mushrooms at any given time. Choose between the two and stick with the gnome that is giving a higher amount of mushrooms. Switch when the amount given starts to lessen.
